items.description: Surge-damaged speaker system and TV set (replacement)
items.rationale: Covered under 2.3.3 as appliances damaged by lightning overvoltage; standard-grade replacement per 7.1.9, capped at EUR 5,000 sub-limit, then halved because no surge protection device was used (2.3.3). Estimated standard value ~2,500-3,000 for both, halved to ~1,400; maximum 2,500.

items.description: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out
items.rationale: Diagnostic/documentation and call-out charges are not repair costs (7.1.8(d), 7.1.8(e)); attendance not tied to itemised indemnifiable repair work, predominant purpose non-indemnifiable under 7.1.10.
